items.title: datasette-arrows 0.1a0
items.text: Release: datasette-arrows 0.1a0 Datasette 1.0a43 added the ability for plugins to implement streaming export formats. Datasette core supports streaming CSV and TSV - you can export millions of lines of data from a table without needing to load it all into memory, because those two file formats support streaming data in chunks. The register_output_renderer() plugin hook can now be used to implement the same pattern for other formats. I've learned never to release a new plugin feature without accompanying it with a plugin that uses it. items.text: Nicholas Matsakis shares why AI makes Rust the ideal choice for modern production systems, skipping steep adoption hurdles via compiler guardrails. He discusses Symposium - an open-source, agent-oriented toolchain from the Rust Foundation - and demonstrates how the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) standardizes agent-to-tool extensibility across diverse enterprise developer workflows.
